// Good to know

Questions, answered

Do I need to provide water or power?
No. Our van carries its own water and power, so all we need is room to park next to your car — at home or at work.
How long does a detail take?
A maintenance wash runs about an hour. A full interior reset or paint enhancement usually takes two to four hours depending on the car's condition.
Which areas do you cover?
Davenport, Kissimmee, St. Cloud, Orlando, Poinciana, Haines City and nearby. Not sure if you're in range? Send us your address and we'll confirm.
How do I pay?
We send a flat quote up front — no surprises. Pay after the final walkaround; most customers use a card or a payment app.
